title: Applied Math I - Chapter 1: Limits and Continuity
content:
1.1 Definition of Limit

Let $f(x)$ be defined on an open interval about $c$, except possibly at $c$ itself. We say that the limit of $f(x)$ as $x$ approaches $c$ is $L$.

Mathematical Notation:
$$\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = L$$

👉 በአማርኛ ማብራሪያ:
ሊሚት ማለት የ $x$ ዋጋ ወደ አንድ ቁጥር ($c$) እየተቃረበ ሲሄድ፣ የ $f(x)$ ውጤት ወደ የትኛው ቁጥር ($L$) ይቃረባል ማለት ነው::


Important Limit Laws

If $\lim_{x \to c} f(x) = L$ and $\lim_{x \to c} g(x) = M$, then:
• Sum Rule: $\lim_{x \to c} [f(x) + g(x)] = L + M$
• Product Rule: $\lim_{x \to c} [f(x) \cdot g(x)] = L \cdot M$
• Quotient Rule: $\lim_{x \to c} \frac{f(x)}{g(x)} = \frac{L}{M}$, provided $M \neq 0$


Worked Example 1 (Evaluating Indeterminate Forms)

Question: Evaluate $\lim_{x \to 2} \frac{x^2 - 4}{x - 2}$

Solution:
• Step 1 (Direct Substitution): If we plug in $x = 2$, we get $\frac{0}{0}$ (Indeterminate Form). So we must factorize.
• Step 2 (Factorization):
$$\frac{x^2 - 4}{x - 2} = \frac{(x - 2)(x + 2)}{x - 2}$$
• Step 3 (Simplify & Evaluate):
$$\lim_{x \to 2} (x + 2) = 2 + 2 = 4$$

💡 Exam Hint: ፈተና ላይ Direct Substitution ስታደርግ $\frac{0}{0}$ የመጣብህ ከሆነ ወዲያውኑ Factorization, Rationalization ወይም L'Hôpital's Rule መጠቀምህን አትርሳ!
